correctness.rationale: For odd n, the doubled-rotation automorphism of D_n identifies the quotient subgroup as its graph in D_n x D_n. The graph core is trivial because Z(D_n)=1; hence the Galois closure has order 4n^2 and quotient degree 2n. Reflections on D_n produce n disjoint 2-cycles, rotations two n-cycles, giving finite-line discriminant order n and infinity-line order 2(n-1). Two commuting coordinate inertia actions classify all nine crossing fibers: finite/finite 1 size-two orbit plus (n-1)/2 size-four orbits; mixed one 2n-orbit; infinity/infinity two n-orbits. Local stabilizer weights give one A1 at each finite/finite crossing and 1/n(1,2), 1/n(1,n-2) at the double infinity crossing. Independently reconstructed D_n orbit types for n=5,7,9. These checks corroborate, not prove, all odd n.
